name: Hotel Milderer Hof
beschreibung: Hotel Milderer Hof is situated in Neustift im Stubaital, framed by the impressive alpine panorama of the Stubai Alps. The hotel provides a peaceful, revitalising atmosphere ideal for nature lovers. Summer opens up extensive alpine hiking trails, while winter offers seamless access to the world-renowned Stubai Glacier. Property highlights include an extensive wellness spa with indoor pool and saunas, elegant balcony rooms, and refined Tyrolean dining.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Milderer Hof in Neustift im Stubaital provides premier spa wellness, panoramic balcony rooms, authentic regional dining, and easy access to the Stubai Glacier.
